# raft/CLAUDE.md, "Acknowledge a snapshot install past its index" (review H1,
# mutSnapshotAckLastIndex): a snapshot installed over a log that matches its
# boundary keeps the suffix, a stale one of another term, and acknowledges
# the snapshot's index alone.
add-nodes 1 voters=1,2,3 term=3 commit=3 log=1,1,1,3,3
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=1,2,3 term=3 log=1,1,1,2,2
----
ok

step 2 type=MsgHeartbeat from=1 term=3
----
ok

process-ready 2
----
> 2 handling Ready
  Messages:
    2->1 MsgHeartbeatResp term=3
  Membership 1@0 2@0 3@0

install-snapshot 2 from=1
----
installed 3/1 from 1

process-ready 2
----
> 2 handling Ready
  seq=1
  Commit 3
  AfterSync:
    2->1 MsgAppResp term=3 index=3
  Compact 3

raft-log 2
----
snapshot 3/1
4/2 command "e4-t2"
5/2 command "e5-t2"
